r1Meta.rule: added = an interview scheduled at R1 OR an assignment triggered at R1, one per application per quarter, cancellations excluded; cleared = reached R2 or beyond on or after that day

signals: an assessment sent, whatever stage it fired in (#222)
an interview HELD at any round except TA Screen and HM Review (#221)

assessedMeta.definition: A = assessed at the stage: an interview held there, an assignment triggered while the candidate was there, or a feedback form with no interview behind it. For App Review, Hello Christy, TA Screen, HM Review, Ref Check, Doc Sub and Offer, A = every candidate who ARRIVED at the stage instead, because that is what the step does. B = of those, entered a later stage afterwards; for Offer, B = went on to be Hired.
assessedMeta.dedupe: one application per stage per quarter; B is a subset of A
assessedMeta.span: assessed at R1 or OA (whichever first) -> reached Ref Check, Documentation or Offer (whichever first)
